decision: Corrected disposable app: 63 local regressions and six staging-twin QA-driver cases pass. Unprimed persona incomplete; no independent engine-issued before/after proof. Not production ready.
fixes: Dedupe using signed Stripe event IDs; record processed only after receipt acceptance.
Serialize state/effects within one process and use stable order/payment receipt idempotency keys.
Reuse PaymentIntents on repeated/concurrent pay and retain payment/refund keys after uncertain responses.
Check signed event shape, test mode, saved payment identity, currency, exact amount and amount_received.
Preserve terminal refund/payment state under late events; send initial receipt even if refund event arrived first.
Track cumulative partial refunds and pending/failed/canceled refund state; consume known failed attempts only once.
Controlled 502/503 provider failures; validate receipt acceptance ID; keep failed receipt events retryable.
Strict quantity/SKU/test-email validation; reject real provider endpoints/live keys and require explicit synthetic config.
Hide cached client_secret from order GET; Resend is the sole receipt sender (no Stripe receipt_email request).

running_process_twins.scope: Actual uvicorn app, Stripe SDK and urllib client via forwarding proxy; synthetic signed success events injected by QA, without payment confirmation. Proxy adds identifying User-Agent and optional X-Flow-Run-Id; it does not fabricate provider responses.
running_process_twins.before: Synthetic event/receipt baseline passed; five scenarios exposed dropped second event, duplicate receipts, repeated PaymentIntents, lost recovery after Resend 503, and unrecorded receipt after accepted response loss. This is not usable end-to-end checkout proof.
running_process_twins.after: Six staging-twin checks passed; see stage-summary.json. Accepted-response-loss independently observed one added provider email, failed callback and retry before response release.
running_process_twins.compatibility: Stripe twin integer amount and synthetic non-null secret repaired on staging. App amount remains strictly integer. Synthetic secret is not usable for real card confirmation. QA forwarding User-Agent avoids edge transport rejection.

Wrong payment id, total, received amount and currency rejected locally; partial refunds tracked.
Original real-process failures reproduced against twins; fixed dedupe passes locally; fixed staging twin duplicate-delivery check passes.
Concurrent payment and receipt delivery tests pass within one process; multiple workers unsupported.
Late failure/success, refund-before-success and stale signatures pass local checks.
No background outbox/reconciliation; real delayed or missing provider events remain unverified.
Synthetic twin keys used; permanent authentication failures/scopes not separately exercised.
Controlled local provider failures tested; original Resend twin 503 and response hold exposed lost recovery. Fixed staging twin recovery after server error passes.

Local payment/refund/email response-loss tests pass. Original twin accepted email after timeout while app lost receipt state; fixed staging twin response-loss recovery passes with independently observed provider count.
Local retry and pending/failed/partial-refund behavior passes; real provider recovery not independently verified.
Known unsupported: all state and dedupe records are process-local.
No durable ledger, background reconciliation or refund-update webhook handler; pending refunds refresh on /refund.
Local pending/failed/canceled/full/partial refunds tested; no access-entitlement feature or customer cancellation flow exists.
Only example.test recipients and isolated endpoint allowlist; secrets redacted in twin traces, cached client_secret hidden from order reads. Auth absent.
Fresh subprocess per twin scenario, loopback listeners stopped, provider probes report cleanup_ok. All new stage sandboxes deleted and private bindings removed.
